plugins.name: project-mgmt
plugins.description: Manages project artifacts in .agents/ — requirements, specs, plans, and documents — with full lifecycle support, cross-linking, and ingest of existing docs.

plugins.name: vps-deploy
plugins.description: General guidance for self-hosted deployments on a VPS: rootless podman, Quadlet units, GHCR, build-once release/promote, podman auto-update, and the choices projects make within that pattern.

plugins.name: make-conventions
plugins.description: Generate, audit and simplify Makefiles into one self-documenting, stack-agnostic surface with grouped generated help, plus a stack detector and Makefile linter.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Disciplined git workflow: atomic commits, Conventional Commits, line-level partial staging, branching, PRs, and history hygiene. Ships the git-workflow skill plus /commit, /branch, /pr, /amend, /cleanup, and /split commands.

plugins.name: agents-pack
plugins.description: Reusable subagents. Currently a template; add task-specific agents here.

plugins.name: hooks-pack
plugins.description: Event hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, etc.). Scaffold — add hook definitions to hooks/hooks.json.

plugins.name: mcp-pack
plugins.description: MCP server declarations. Scaffold — add servers to .mcp.json.
